confirmed_issues.instruction: The expression does not correctly model the sequence construction. The sequence is built by appending triples (a, b, c) in order, so the n-th element is not necessarily the (n-1)-th index of a generated sequence for each n. Instead, the sequence is constructed by repeatedly appending triples, so the n-th element is the (n-1)-th element of the flattened sequence of all triples. The expression must reflect this by generating the sequence correctly and indexing into the flattened sequence.
